text.alreadyLinked: This chat is already linked to an account.
text.appsImport: How to connect Open the link below on the device that has the app — the subscription adds itself:
text.appsIntro: 📱 Apps Pick yours — I will send the install link and the one that connects it.
text.appsManual: How to connect This app cannot add a subscription by itself. Copy the link with the button below and paste it into the app.
text.autoRenewNeedsCard: 🔄 Auto-renewal No card is linked, so there is nothing to charge. Link one in your account on the site and the subscription will renew itself.
text.autoRenewOff: 🔄 Auto-renewal is off Access ends on {date} and nothing will be charged.
text.autoRenewOn: 🔄 Auto-renewal is on The next period is charged to your card automatically — nothing to do.
text.autoRenewTrial: 🔄 Auto-renewal There is nothing to renew during the free day — it is never charged. Subscribe with the “Renew” button: the paid period starts right after the free day, so you keep the time that is left.
text.autoRenewUnavailable: 🔄 Auto-renewal Automatic charges are not available right now — renew by hand with the “Renew” button.
text.chargeFailed: ❌ The card could not be charged Access works until {date}. Renew by hand — another card works too. We will not try to charge again this period.
text.checkoutIntro: 💳 Payment: {plan} Amount: {amount} RUB. Access opens the moment the payment goes through — I will message you here.
text.choosePlan: 💳 Pick a term The longer it is, the cheaper the month. Every plan has every country and both protocols.
text.codeInvalid: ⚠️ That code did not work It is unknown, already used or expired. Get a new one on the site, in the “Telegram” section.
text.deleteAsk:
🗑️ Delete the account?
The subscription stops with no refund for the time left, devices disconnect and the link stops working.
We will not be able to restore it.
text.deleted: The account is deleted. Thank you for being with us 👋
text.deviceAdded: 📲 New device {name} Devices: {count} of {limit}. Not you? Remove it in “Devices” and change the link with /rotate.
text.deviceBlocked: ⛔ Device not connected {name} is asking for servers, but every place is taken: {limit} of {limit}. Remove an old device or add a place, then refresh the subscription in the app.
text.deviceGone: That device is no longer on the list — it seems it was removed already.
text.deviceRemoveAsk: Remove {name}? The app on it stops connecting within a few minutes and its place frees up. If the app refreshes the subscription again it takes the place back — so remove the subscription in the app first.
text.deviceRemoved: ✅ Device removed — its keys stop working within a few minutes.
text.devicesAdded: ✅ Places added The new limit is already in effect, and the link stays the same.
text.devicesEmpty: None yet. A device shows up here once its app refreshes the subscription for the first time.
text.devicesExtra: Need more places? Each is {price} RUB, paid once.
text.devicesFull: No more places can be added
text.devicesIntro: 📲 Extra places: +{count} Amount: {amount} RUB. The limit grows the moment the payment goes through — I will message you here.
text.devicesShrunk: ⚠️ The device limit went down to {limit} No longer getting servers: {names}. Add places or choose which device to remove.
text.endingSoon: ⏳ The subscription ends on {date} Renew it so your access does not stop.
text.expired: 🔒 The subscription has ended Access is off. Subscribe to bring it back — the link in your app starts working again.
text.failed: 😵 Something went wrong. Please try again in a minute.
text.help:
❓ Help Everything is on the buttons below. The ones you need most: 🚀 Connect — the link for your app 📱 Apps — what to install and how to connect 📊 Subscription — term, plan, renewal 📲 Devices — remove one or add a place 💳 Subscribe or Renew — pay for access 🎁 Free day — one day for free
The rest is under “⚙️ More” 🔄 Auto-charge — turn charges on or off 🔁 New link — if the old one got into the wrong hands 🌐 Website — a one-time sign-in to your account 🌍 Language — switch language 🔌 Unlink — disconnect this chat from the account 🗑️ Delete — delete the account and its subscription
Something not working? Write to support on the site.
text.inactive: 📊 No active subscription Subscribe and access opens the moment you pay.
text.legacyRetired: 🔐 Every device now has keys of its own If a device stopped connecting, open the VPN app on it and refresh the subscription.
text.linkIntro: 🚀 Your subscription link Copy it and add it to your app:
text.linkWarning: Do not forward the link to anyone — it is as good as access to your subscription. If it leaked, change it with /rotate.
text.linked: ✅ This chat is linked to your account Everything is managed from here now, with the buttons below.
text.noSubscription: 🔒 No subscription yet Try a free day or subscribe straight away.
text.paid: 🎉 Payment received The subscription is active until {date}. Press “Connect” to get your link.
text.planChangeLocked: The term can change once the current period ends. To renew, pick the plan you are on.
text.renewManual: No card is linked — renew by hand with the “Renew” button.
text.renewSoon: 🔄 Renewal coming up The subscription runs until {date}. A day before that we charge {amount} RUB to the card {card} and it renews.
text.rotateAsk: 🔁 Change the link? The old one stops working, and the new one has to be added to every app again.
text.rotateDone: 🔁 The link is new The old one no longer works. Add this one to your app:
text.start: 👋 GnomeVPN — a fast VPN with no speed limits. 🎬 YouTube in 4K, social media, games 📱 iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS and TVs Your account was created from this chat — nothing to fill in. Start with a free day or subscribe with the buttons below. The same account opens on the site {site} — “🌐 Website” under “⚙️ More” signs you in.
text.trialEndingSoon: ⏳ The free day is almost over Subscribe so your access does not stop.
text.trialEnds: You can subscribe right now with the “Renew” button — the paid period starts right after the free day, so you keep the time that is left.
text.trialGranted: 🎁 Your free day has started 24 hours of full access: every country, both protocols, no speed limits. Press “Connect” to get your link.
text.trialNeedsEmail: Confirm your email on the site first — the message is already on its way to the address on your account.
text.trialUnavailable:
The free day is already used — it is given once.

Press “Subscribe” to get a subscription.
text.unlinkAsk: 🔌 Unlink this chat? The subscription and access stay; you can still sign in to your account with your email.
text.unlinkNoEmail: 🔌 This chat cannot be unlinked yet This account was created in Telegram and has no other way in. Unlink it now and the subscription stays, but nothing can open it. Add an email in your account and set a password with “Forgot password?” first — then unlinking is safe.
text.unlinked: This chat is unlinked. The subscription and access are untouched — come back any time.
text.websiteIntro: 🌐 Sign in on the site The link works once and lives for 10 minutes — do not forward it to anyone.
